## The Instrument structure


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

module_summaries <- readRDS("module_summaries.rds")

make_item_callouts <- function(item_list) {
  if (is.null(item_list) || length(item_list) == 0) return("")

  blocks <- lapply(item_list, function(it) {
    # Print in red if there is mismatch between them
    callout_type <- switch(it$flag, 
                           no = 'tip', 
                           yes = 'important',
                           maybe = 'warning')
    
    # Ensure no empty labels (they mess up the titles)
    label <- if (is.na(it$label) || nchar(it$label) < 2) "*[No label]*" else trimws(it$label)

    tab_lines <- knitr::kable(it$compr, format = "markdown")
    
    paste0(
      '::: {.callout-', callout_type,
      ' collapse="true" title="', label, ' (**', it$name, '**)"}\n\n',
      paste(tab_lines, collapse = "\n"),
      '\n\n:::\n\n'
    )
  })

  paste0(blocks, collapse = "")
}

for (mod in names(module_summaries)) {
  ms <- module_summaries[[mod]]

  cat('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="', mod, '"}\n\n', sep = "")
  cat(ms$n_items, "items,\t", ms$n_symptoms, "symptoms, and\t", ms$n_diagnoses,"diagnoses\n\n")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

  if (ms$n_screener == 0 && ms$n_supplement == 0) {
    cat("### Intro items\n\n")
    cat(make_item_callouts(ms$other))
  
  }
  if (ms$n_screener > 0) {
    cat("### Screeners (", ms$n_screener, " items)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(make_item_callouts(ms$screener))
  }
  if (ms$n_supplement > 0) {
    cat("### Supplements (", ms$n_supplement, " items)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(make_item_callouts(ms$supplement))
  }
  if (ms$n_symptoms > 0) {
    cat("### Symptoms (", ms$n_symptoms, " items)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(make_item_callouts(ms$symptoms))
  }
  if (ms$n_diagnoses > 0) {
    cat("### Diagnoses (", ms$n_diagnoses, " items)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(make_item_callouts(ms$diagnoses))
  }
  if (ms$n_aggr_diagnoses > 0) {
    cat("### Aggregate diagnoses (", ms$n_aggr_diagnoses, " items)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(make_item_callouts(ms$aggr_diagnoses))
  }

  cat(":::\n\n")
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```
